name: Single custodian
summary: Exchange/hosted wallet (e.g. Kraken) with stronger auth. Convenience and support recovery; residual counterparty, phishing, freeze, and insolvency risk.

name: Federated custody
summary: Community/federation custody (e.g. Fedi): payments and privacy tradeoffs; collusion, jurisdiction, and seed-loss risks.

name: Single-key hot wallet
summary: Self-custody on an internet-connected device: convenient spending; malware and seed handling dominate risk.

name: Single-key cold wallet
summary: Hardware or air-gapped single signature: stronger malware resistance when used correctly; supply-chain, entropy, and backups matter.

name: Multisig (distributed)
summary: m-of-n with geographic/party distribution: removes single points of failure; watch same-vendor and same-country correlation.
